title: Donation intake with a donor receipt
description: A charity or thrift store's record of donated goods taken in, kept in Desk. Each PP DON Donation holds the donor (one of the retailer's customers, whose name and e-mail it shows, or a donor typed in, or no one named), the donor's address for the receipt, the store that took the goods in and the day, and the goods: each kind, what it is, how many (items, bags or boxes) and its condition. A workflow moves it Received, then Give receipt to Receipt given, or Cancel to Cancelled; once a donation is Receipt given or Cancelled, a save rule stops its donor, store, day and goods from changing; the receipt reads the donation's state. It prints as the donor receipt under the retailer's own letter head, which states no value for the goods. The report Donations lists every donation not cancelled, newest first. A field on Stock Entry, Donation, names the donation whose goods a Material Receipt takes into stock (the Stock Entry list filters by it); a customer's donations show under the customer. The lock installs switched off, as every save rule does: the retailer switches it on. The app moves no money and changes no stock, and calls nothing outside: no service, no outside address.

fields.label: Kind of goods
fields.description: Such as clothing, books, household, toys, furniture.

fields.label: What it is
fields.description: As the receipt will describe it: children's coats, a box of paperbacks.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: When the donor is one of your customers. Optional: a donor who is not one is typed below.

fields.label: Customer name
fields.description: The customer's name, as the receipt prints it when no donor is typed. Change it on the customer.

fields.label: Customer's e-mail
fields.description: The customer's Email, as the till keeps it. Your own Notification can send the receipt to it.

fields.label: Donor
fields.description: A donor who is not one of your customers, as the receipt names them. Leave the donor and the customer blank for a donor who gives no name: the receipt then says an anonymous donor.

fields.label: Donor's e-mail
fields.description: Your own Notification can send the receipt to it.

fields.label: Donor's address
fields.description: Printed on the receipt, for a donor who wants it there.

fields.label: Received at
fields.description: The store that took the goods in.

fields.label: Receipt given
fields.description: Ticked by Give receipt. From then on the donor, the store, the day and the goods cannot change. Your own Notification on its change can e-mail the receipt, with the condition doc.receipt_given in (1, "1") and (doc.donor_email or doc.customer_email).

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: For the store only: never printed.

custom_fields.label: Donation
custom_fields.description: The donation whose goods this Material Receipt takes into stock. Optional.

save_rules.rule_name: PP DON donation locked once its receipt is given
save_rules.message: The receipt was given: the donor, the store, the day and the goods stay as on it. Cancel it and take a new donation instead.
